{{Top|leg}}
A '''solid-state detonator''' was a type of [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]]. It was almost fail-safe in its operation. [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]] attempting to blow up [[Silver Station]] used a solid-state detonator on their explosive device.<ref name="SWAJ6">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref>
